verdicts.reason: Both break the art apart in the same way: the pale circle is pushed to the left edge and clipped, while a tiny can floats alone at the far right, so the product is trivial and the canvas is lopsided. Both also put the brand wordmark below the headline. A stacks four rows into the 70px height with no breathing room: the headline hugs the top edge, the pills hug the bottom, and the small CTA pill is the same size as the badges. B is slightly better because it has a larger headline and roomier buttons, but its body copy is shrunk to illegible micro text and tacked on after the badges, and its CTA is still not dominant.
